findings.fix: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` after the charset meta tag.
findings.violation: The page lacks a viewport meta tag needed for proper responsive design on mobile devices.

findings.evidence: Both "Full name" field with `name="full_name"` and separate "First name"/"Last name" fields with `name="given_name"` and `name="family_name"`
findings.fix: Remove either the "Full name" field or the separate first/last name fields, not both.
findings.violation: The form asks for both a full name and separate first/last name fields, creating redundant and conflicting data.

findings.fix: Remove this paragraph or move it to a success page shown after form submission.

findings.evidence: `placeholder="Must be 8 digits"` with no validation attributes
findings.violation: The membership number field promises "Must be 8 digits" but has no `pattern`, `minlength`, or `maxlength` attributes to enforce this requirement.

findings.fix: Add `name="shipping_speed"` (or appropriate field name) to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element lacks a `name` attribute, so its value will not be submitted with the form data.

findings.fix: Remove the inline `style="font-size:16px"` or apply consistent styling to all form inputs via CSS.
findings.violation: Only this form field has inline `font-size` styling, making it inconsistent with other fields.

findings.fix: Change `type="text"` to `type="time"` or `type="datetime-local"` depending on whether you need just the time or date and time.
findings.violation: A field labeled "Preferred contact time" uses `type="text"` instead of a proper time/datetime input type.

findings.fix: Either remove the button if not needed, or apply reasonable styling like `style="padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px"`.
findings.violation: The button has extremely small padding (1px 2px) and font size (11px), making it difficult to read and click.
